decision: Selected the planar centroid of the union of the four Stokes County tax parcels named in the Project Delta conditional rezoning notice (PINs 6964-91-8321, 6973-49-0574, 6973-76-7124 and 6973-73-4188), as published in the NC OneMap statewide parcel service, as the campus locator for the proposed Project Delta data center.
layer: NC OneMap NC1Map_Parcels FeatureServer layer 1 (Parcels (polys)), the NC Integrated Cadastral Data Exchange aggregation of county parcel data; Stokes County source rows; native CRS NAD83 North Carolina State Plane ftUS (EPSG:2264)

computed.method: Planar centroid of the shapely union of the four WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygons; cross-checked against the centroid of the native EPSG:2264 union transformed with pyproj; geodesic areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: The Stokes County Board of Commissioners legal notice for the 8 September 2026 public hearing (posted 20 August 2026) lists Parcel PINs 6964-91-8321, 6973-49-0574, 6973-76-7124 and 6973-73-4188, about 1,848.74 acres along US Highway 311, Tuttle Road, Oldtown Road and Coon Joyce Road near Walnut Cove, for the Project Delta conditional rezoning to M-2-CZ with a data center as the permitted use.

The petitioner's conditional rezoning application (filed July 2026) gives the same four PINs with site addresses 0 US Highway 311 & Tuttle Road, 0 Off US 311 Highway, 1290 Coon Joyce Road and 1203 Tuttle Road, and the applicant's site plan states the same PINs and +/- 1,848.74 total acres.

NC OneMap returns exactly one Stokes County polygon feature for each PIN, with site addresses matching the application (0 US HWY 311 & TUTTLE RD, 0 OFF US 311 HWY, 1290 COON JOYCE RD, 1203 TUTTLE RD); their geodesic area totals about 1,827.6 acres, 1.1% below the stated acreage.
unresolved: The NC OneMap owner field is not used: for one parcel it is older than the July 2026 application, which names DFC Stokes, LLC and DFC Stokes 2, LLC as the owners. Owner fields are not reproduced here.
The applicant's land-use plan shows northern and southern development areas inside buffers; building positions are not published, so the point locates the rezoned holding as a whole.
